classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a direct video recording of a parliamentary debate, created at the time of the events by the Council of States.
classification.resume: This document is a parliamentary motion concerning the construction of a second tube for the Gotthard road tunnel, debated in the Council of States on 16 March 2011. The motion was authored by Filippo Lombardi and discussed by Christoffel Brändli, Hansheiri Inderkum, and Dick Marty. It is a video recording of the debate.
